description: Bulk activate or deactivate every workflow carrying a tag — an operational kill switch (e.g. deactivate everything tagged 'client-x'). Runs as a dry run by default; set dryRun=false to apply. Workflows already in the desired state are skipped.

active.description: Desired state: true = activate, false = deactivate

dryRun.description: Preview affected workflows without changing them

name: set_workflows_active_by_tag
